sensors.name: line tracker as floor brightness (LIGHT, LINETRACKER)

actions.name: drive forward at 40 % until another movement

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the line tracker's floor brightness is below 70 % (the black line), drive forward at 40 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.
Every call returns at once, so the outer loop repeats the same three checks many times a second.

likely_intent.description: Drive along the line through a tunnel and come out of it.

decision_points.condition: the line tracker's floor brightness is below 70 % (a black line)

branches.outcome: black line: the robot drives forward at 40 %
bright floor (white band or peach floor): it checks for a wall

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is less than 3 cm ahead of the front sensor

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: the robot stops
nothing ahead: it follows the line

branches.reason: followLine runs only after the same line tracker read 70 % or more, and the robot does not move before that read: black is below 70 %, so this outcome never happens.

scenarios.coded_response: While the line tracker reads black it drives forward at 40 % again and again, so it drives straight along the line through the tunnel.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a black line that runs straight through a tunnel, with a goal on the line past the tunnel's far end.
scenarios.title: Gets through the tunnel
assumptions: A line runs through the tunnel and the goal is past its far end: your program steers only by the line.
The tunnel is straight: you didn't say it bends.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It drives through the tunnel along the line to the goal and bumps into none of the tunnel's walls.

scenarios.coded_response: It stops while the wall is ahead.

scenarios.title: Stops at a wall on the bright floor

scenarios.coded_response: It curves right, again and again, so it drives in a circle.

scenarios.trigger: The line tracker reads no black and no obstacle is ahead
scenarios.title: Curves right off the line

uncertainties: You didn't say that a line runs through the tunnel or where its exit is: the test takes a line through a straight tunnel with the goal past it.
Dim light under the tunnel's roof changes nothing this program reads: the line tracker measures the floor, not the room.
The 'sees black' check in followLine can never hold, because followLine runs only when the same line tracker read 70 % or more: off the line the robot always curves right.
A tunnel that bends is not tested: on a black line the robot drives straight, and you didn't say what it should do at a wall in the light.

planned: Drives through the tunnel to the goal
